name: Dual-dispatch message duplication between client app.js and server.js
evidence: Client app.js (6 call sites) and server.js fire concurrent POST requests to GAS Webhook for identical events, producing 2 duplicate Zalo messages per event.

name: Public unauthenticated exposure of school seal and teacher signatures on /uploads
evidence: GET /uploads/signatures/school_seal.png returned HTTP 200 (2990 bytes) and sig_user_cvaty.png returned HTTP 200 (87869 bytes) with zero authentication!

name: Absence of Zalo OA v3 OAuth 2.0 PKCE refresh token architecture
evidence: Codebase strictly uses static Zalo Bot Platform token (bot-api.zaloplatforms.com). Lacks OAuth 2.0 PKCE refresh flow, 25h access_token rotation, and concurrency mutex required for official Zalo OA verification.
